battle.name: 邙山之戰
battle.brief: 東魏武定元年（543），西魏軍隊由崤函方向東出，爭取洛陽；東魏以洛州與河南之兵據洛陽以北的邙山迎擊，交鋒後西魏退回關中。史籍於此役只存大略，兵員與斬獲都無明文。卡面這件秦連弩出自戰國秦地，與漢弩一脈相承：弩機儲力、機括自動分次發矢，守城一方靠它把進逼的騎步壓在牆外。

kit.name: 秦連弩
kit.history: 弩機把拉力存起來，一踩一發。守城的一方靠它把攻城的人壓在牆外。

countries: 交戰的兩方是東魏與西魏。北魏在延昌末年崩解，高歡擁立孝靜帝元善見於鄴，遷都鄴城，自居晉陽的霸府握有實權；宇文泰奉孝武帝西奔長安，挾元寶炬立西魏，以關中為根本。543年歲在東魏武定元年、西魏大統九年。東魏這邊，政令與軍令出在鄴的中樞：孝靜帝居虛位，渤海王高澄以司空、錄尚書事總領朝政，兵事則歸晉陽的高歡，行臺與州郡各自管領兵馬，黃河與驛道把晉陽、鄴、洛陽三點串成一條線；西線以洛州刺史賀拔仁鎮洛陽，與河南大將軍侯景並為東魏在河洛的柱石。西魏那邊，宇文泰以大行台總制關中，軍府制以八柱國十二大將軍統兵，府兵與屯田相配合，兵源與糧源出自關中隴右的鄉兵與軍將，漢人與關隴豪右在西魏軍中佔多數；高歡軍中則胡漢雜處，騎兵比例高，號令與糧秣由霸府直接調度。洛陽一線之外，柔然在漠北虎視，是雙方共同的第三方：東魏同年要分兵應付柔然南下，西魏則把關中的主力留在關北與西北守備，兩家的出兵都因此受到牽制。
countriesEn: The two sides in this engagement were Eastern Wei and Western Wei. The Northern Wei came apart at the end of the Yanchang era: Gao Huan set up the emperor Xiaojing, Yuan Xianjian, at Ye, moved the capital there, and kept the real power in his own hands at the stronghold of Jinyang, while Yuwen Tai followed the emperor Xiaowu west to Chang'an, installed Yuan Baoju, and made the Guanzhong basin his base. The year 543 is the first year of the Wuding era in Eastern Wei and the ninth year of the Datong era in Western Wei. On the Eastern Wei side the government and the orders of war issued from the central offices at Ye: the emperor was a figurehead, the Prince of Bohai Gao Cheng handled the business of state as chancellor and recorder of the Secretariat, and military affairs belonged to Gao Huan at Jinyang, with the regional administrations and the prefectures raising and feeding their own troops, while the Yellow River and the post roads strung Jinyang, Ye and Luoyang into a single line. On the western line the Prefect of Luozhou, He Jin, held Luoyang, and he and the Grand General of Henan, Hou Jing, stood together as the pillars of Eastern Wei on the Heluo front. In the west, Yuwen Tai presided over Guanzhong as grand chancellor of the realm, and the system of the military houses, with its eight pillar lords and twelve general leaders, gave him his command; the soldiers of the households and the army officers were fed by the farming garrisons and by the land and poll tax, and the Han and the powerful families of Guanzhong and Longyou made up the greater part of the Western Wei army, while Gao Huan's host mixed Chinese and Hu and carried a high proportion of horsemen, its orders and its grain moving directly out of the stronghold. Beyond the Luoyang line the Rouran watched from the northern steppe and were a third party common to both: in this same year Eastern Wei had to split its forces to meet a Rouran move south, and Western Wei kept the main body of its troops in the north of the passes and in the north-west, so that the expeditions of both were held in check by other demands.
people: 留下姓名的，以高歡、宇文泰、高澄三人最關鍵。高歡是東魏的實際統帥，出身爾朱氏部下的鎮將，靠驍勇與手腕收攏河北豪族與軍頭，掌兵於晉陽，把洛陽與西線視為不可讓之地；高澄是他在鄴的耳目與代理人，父子先後柄政，把東魏的政令與軍權收在一門之內。宇文泰是西魏的奠基者，自孝武帝西奔即以大行台攬關中，與從龍起家的將領以八柱國之制結成一體，用屯田與租調養兵，平日坐鎮長安，兵出則自長安東指崤函。西線的具體指揮者，今存記載已經模糊：東魏方面，鎮守洛陽多年的洛州刺史賀拔仁出身北魏鎮將之族，久與東魏相安，是洛陽防務的主幹；河南大將軍侯景原為爾朱氏部將，後歸高歡，以驍騎見長，是東魏在河洛唯一能快速集結的機動力量，也是日後與高氏生隙的關鍵人物。除名字之外，各道行軍的將領、州縣兵、軍士與附屬部眾的姓名多已不傳，只有《北齊書》《北史》《魏書》在紀傳之中留下零星幾筆，其中涉及此役的，多為領兵者與據守城池者的官銜，具體的名單與行止並不完整。
peopleEn: Three names matter most. Gao Huan was the effective commander of Eastern Wei: he had come up out of the garrison officers of the Erzhu clan, made himself known for his daring and his way with men, gathered the great families and the military captains of Hebei around himself, held the army at Jinyang, and treated Luoyang and the western line as ground that could not be given up. Gao Cheng was his eyes and ears and his agent at Ye; the father and the son held the government in turn, gathering the orders of state and the command of the troops into one family. Yuwen Tai was the founder of Western Wei: from the moment the emperor Xiaowu fled west he took charge of Guanzhong as grand chancellor of the realm, bound himself to the generals who had risen with him through the institution of the eight pillar lords, fed his soldiers by the farming garrisons and the taxes, sat at Chang'an in the ordinary way, and pointed his troops east towards the mountains of Xiaohan when he sent them out. The commander in the field on that line has grown blurred in the record: on the Eastern Wei side, the Prefect of Luozhou, He Jin, came of a family of Northern Wei garrison commanders, had lived in accord with Eastern Wei for many years, and was the backbone of the defence of Luoyang; the Grand General of Henan, Hou Jing, had been an officer of the Erzhu clan before he came over to Gao Huan, was known above all for his bold cavalry, was the one mobile force in the Heluo region that Eastern Wei could bring together quickly, and was later the man who fell out with the Gao house. Beyond the names, the commanders of the several circuits, the prefectural soldiers, the men in the ranks and the attached dependents have left few names, and only scattered lines in the Records of Northern Qi, of the Northern History and of Wei survive; what touches on this engagement is mostly the rank of those who led troops and of those who held cities, and the roll of names and of movements is not complete.
kits: 卡面這件秦連弩，設計上的名號是秦弩，出土於戰國秦地的弩機銘文與墓葬器械之中，形制要點在弩機：弦扣在機匣的懸弦與棘爪之間，扣弦之後拉力由機括保存，扳機一按，弦矢一次射出，弩機另有望山作為瞄具，可以照標尺定遠近；機上零件的公差細到以毫釐計，銅件與木件配合嚴密，說明秦人已把弩做成可以大量複製的制式裝備。漢承秦制，弩成為漢軍主力的射手裝備，蹶張弩上弦時一腳踩住弩機，臂張弩用於更遠的距離，床弩與弩車把同樣的原理放大到城頭與陣前。南北朝的戰場上，弩仍是守城與野戰的骨幹：守方以弩列覆蓋城門、馬道與塹坡，把進逼的攻城者壓在射界之內；攻方則以雲梯、撞車、攻城樓與石車靠近，弩在城頭與陣前互相消耗，射手的補充與弩機的維修都靠城內的後勤。騎兵靠弓與長槊，步兵靠長刀、戟與大盾，鎧甲以札甲、裲襠甲為主，馬匹多半只披護住胸腹的皮質馬具。卡面這件秦弩雖早於此役七百餘年，它所代表的技術傳統卻正是南北朝城頭上仍在服役的東西，兩者之間的連續，是這場戰役裡最值得留意的一條線。
kitsEn: The repeating crossbow on the card carries the design name of the Qin crossbow, and it is known from the inscriptions on crossbow triggers and from the grave goods of Qin territory in the Warring States period. The point of its form lies in the trigger mechanism: the string is held between the drawn string of the housing and the catch of the ratchet, and once the string is drawn the pull is stored in the mechanism; press the trigger and the bolt goes once, and the mechanism also carried a sighting device known as the wangshan, by which the range could be set against a scale. The parts were made to tolerances as fine as the fraction of a millimetre, with bronze working against wood in close fit, which shows that the Qin had already turned the crossbow into a standard piece of equipment that could be produced in large numbers. The Han inherited the Qin system and the crossbow became the main weapon of the Han foot archer: the foot-and-thigh crossbow was loaded by putting one foot on the mechanism, the arm-drawing crossbow served at longer ranges, and the bed crossbow and the crossbow cart scaled the same principle up to the wall head and the front of the line. On the battlefields of the Northern and Southern dynasties the crossbow was still the backbone of both the defence and the field: the defenders covered the gates, the wall walks and the slopes of the ditch with lines of crossbows and pressed the men coming up against the walls inside the arc of fire, while the attackers brought up scaling ladders, battering rams, siege towers and stone carts, and the crossbows on the walls and in front of the line consumed each other, the ammunition for the archers and the repair of the mechanisms both depending on the logistics inside the city. The cavalry used the bow and the long spear, the foot the long sabre, the halberd and the large shield, the body armour was chiefly the plated coat and the padded coat, and the horses usually wore only leather chamfron and breast covering. The Qin crossbow on the card is more than seven hundred years older than this battle, but the technical tradition it stands for was exactly what was still in service on the walls in the sixth century, and that continuity is the most interesting line in this engagement.
tactics: 邙山是洛陽城正北的一道東西向土崗，北面就是黃河，山體之間夾著南北向的谷口與河灘，東面通向孟津渡口，西面連著崤函古道的出口。東魏守洛陽，必須把這幾條狹窄的通道守住；西魏軍由關中沿崤山北麓的谷道東出，若要進入中原腹地，幾乎必經過這幾個口子。打法因此是通道戰而不是野會戰：斥候先行，烽燧接力報警，東魏以洛州兵據山崗與塹線布弩，弓弩壓住谷口出口，騎兵分遣兩翼，準備在對方隊形被地形拉長時以縱兵衝擊；西魏多以輕騎前出試探，步兵結陣護著騎兵，試圖把通過谷口的隊形拉成縱隊，兩翼一旦被牽制，後隊就難以展開。西魏關中糧秣有限，遠出關中數百里而不能持久，東魏則有洛陽與黃河南岸的漕運可以接濟，所以西軍的攻勢多在秋收前後、糧草充足的季節發動，一有不利即退回崤函。冬季的寒冷與春初的水位，還有渡口的淤塞與河道的淺澀，同樣左右著這條戰線的節奏。
tacticsEn: Mount Mang is a ridge of earth running east and west directly north of the city of Luoyang, with the Yellow River to the north of it; the body of the hill is cut by gullies and strips of river flat that run north and south, the eastern end of the ridge leads to the crossing at Mengjin, and the western end joins the exit of the ancient road through the Xiaohan mountains. To hold Luoyang, Eastern Wei had to hold those narrow passages; the army of Western Wei came east from Guanzhong along the valleys at the northern foot of the Xiaohan range, and to reach the belly of the plain it had to pass through one of those gaps. The fighting was therefore a battle of the passes rather than a general engagement in the open: the outposts went ahead, the beacon towers passed the alarm along the line, Eastern Wei deployed the troops of Luozhou along the ridge and the ditches with the crossbows placed to cover the mouths of the gullies, and the cavalry were split to the two wings, ready to charge once the enemy's column had been stretched by the ground. Western Wei sent light horse forward to feel the way, with the foot closed up to protect them, trying to draw the column that came through the gaps into a long and narrow shape, for once the two wings were held the rear could not deploy. The grain of Guanzhong was limited and an army that went out several hundred li from the passes could not stay long, while Eastern Wei could be supplied from Luoyang and from the water transport on the south bank of the Yellow River, so the offensive of the western army was usually launched in the season after the harvest, when the grain was plentiful, and any reverse sent it back at once towards the Xiaohan passes. The cold of winter, the rising water at the beginning of spring, the silting of the crossings and the shallows of the river all had their say in the rhythm of this front.
data: 可核對的數字不多。年份是543年，即東魏武定元年、西魏大統九年；邙山在洛陽城正北，山崗距城約十餘里，東西綿延數十里，北面即黃河，東接孟津。現存史書沒有留下這場戰役的兵員、斬獲與俘虜數目，《北齊書》《北史》與《資治通鑑》於此都只存大略，因此任何精確的傷亡數字都沒有根據，寫作時只能以兵力的量級與制度的規模去描述。可用的只有制度上的數量級：東魏的洛州是西線重鎮，河南大將軍侯景的部眾是河洛唯一可以快速集結的機動兵力，而西魏的兵源受八柱國十二大將軍的軍府編制限制，關中糧食由屯田與租調供應，出關作戰的成本遠高於東魏守土。器械方面的數字可以從器物本身推：漢代與南北朝的弩標稱弓力多在三石至八石之間，約合今日二十至六十公斤的拉力，弩的常用有效射程在一百至二百步，強弩可及三百步，望山則使遠距離射擊的精度大幅提高；秦弩機的零件公差細到以毫釐計，說明這是能大量複製的制式裝備。以上數字都在說明同一件事：邙山這樣的地形，靠的不是雙方傾巢而出的會戰，而是誰能先把幾條通道口用弩與塹線封住。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked are few. The year is 543, that is the first year of Wuding in Eastern Wei and the ninth year of Datong in Western Wei; Mount Mang lies directly north of the city of Luoyang, the ridge standing perhaps ten li or more from the city and running east and west for several tens of li, with the Yellow River to the north and Mengjin to the east. The surviving histories leave no tally of the troops engaged, of the slain or of the prisoners in this engagement; the Records of Northern Qi, the Northern History and the Comprehensive Mirror all keep it in outline, so no exact figure of losses has any basis, and the force can only be described by the order of magnitude and the scale of the institutions involved. What can be used are the institutional magnitudes: Luozhou was the strong place on the western line, and the troops of the Grand General of Henan, Hou Jing, were the one mobile force in the Heluo region that could be assembled quickly, while on the Western Wei side the soldiers were limited by the organisation of the military houses with their eight pillar lords and twelve general leaders, and the grain of Guanzhong came from the farming garrisons and the taxes, so that an expedition out of the passes cost far more than holding the ground. The figures of the machines can be worked out from the objects themselves: the crossbows of the Han and of the Northern and Southern dynasties were commonly rated between three and eight dan of pull, which works out at roughly twenty to sixty kilogrammes of draw today, the usual effective range of a crossbow was a hundred to two hundred bu, with the stronger pieces reaching three hundred, and the sighting device known as the wangshan raised the accuracy of long range shooting considerably; the parts of the Qin trigger mechanism were made to tolerances as fine as the fraction of a millimetre, which shows a standard piece of equipment that could be produced in large numbers. All these figures point at one thing: a position such as Mount Mang was not decided by a general engagement in which both sides emptied their cupboards, but by whoever could seal the mouths of the few passes with crossbows and ditches first.
cause: 打起來的起因有三層。最直接的一層是洛陽的戰略地位：洛陽是東魏的西境門戶，北面有邙山可以作屏障，東面扼住孟津的渡口，西面通往崤函，誰控制洛陽，誰就控制關中進入中原的門戶，也控制住河洛一線的漕運與糧源。第二層是北魏崩解之後的正面競爭：孝武帝西奔、高歡另立元善見，東西兩家都要爭正統與天下，鄴與長安都不能容忍對方坐大河洛，任何一方在洛陽得手，都會把東西的分界線往西推。第三層是同年的外部牽制：543年柔然南下，東魏的主力必須留在晉陽與北方應付草原，西魏也必須把關中的兵留在關北與西北守備，能投到洛陽一線的兵因此有限，這場戰役的規模也就被壓在牽制之下。於是雙方都明白同一件事：洛陽要守，但不能在洛陽耗盡家底；關中可以出，但不能出得太遠，退路必須留在崤函之內。
causeEn: There are three layers behind the outbreak of the fighting. The most immediate is the strategic position of Luoyang: Luoyang was the gateway of the western line of Eastern Wei, with Mount Mang as a screen to the north, the crossing at Mengjin held on the east, and the road through the Xiaohan mountains on the west; whoever held Luoyang held the doorway by which Guanzhong entered the Central Plain, and held the water transport and the grain of the Heluo line as well. The second layer is the open competition that followed the collapse of the Northern Wei: the emperor Xiaowu fled west, Gao Huan set up Yuan Xianjian in his own right, and the two houses had to fight over the legitimacy and over the realm; neither Ye nor Changan could afford to let the other sit comfortably on Luoyang, and a gain there by either side would push the line between east and west further to the west. The third layer is the external pull of the same year: the Rouran came south in 543, the main body of Eastern Wei had to stay at Jinyang and in the north to answer the steppe, and Western Wei likewise had to keep troops in the north of the passes and in the north-west, so that the forces that could be put into the Luoyang line were few, and the scale of the engagement was pressed down by those competing demands. Both sides understood the same thing: Luoyang had to be held, but the household could not be spent on it; Guanzhong could send an army out, but not too far, and the line of retreat had to stay inside the Xiaohan passes.
impact: 這一仗的直接影響，是洛陽與邙山一線在往後十餘年裡維持在東魏、也就是後來北齊的手中，東西分界線沿著崤山北麓與黃河南岸大致固定下來，西魏的出關行動屢屢被擋在谷口之外，中原的南北通道繼續由北朝一方掌握。間接的影響更大一層：洛州與河南的守禦體系因此被加固，塹壕、塢堡與烽燧的聯繫在黃河南岸重新串起，潼關一線與洛陽之間的傳報距離縮短，河洛的漕運也再度成為北朝的運血線，而龐大的關中軍隊則要靠長距離的糧道維持。對兵器而言，這幾年反覆的守城與前哨交鋒讓弩在體系中的位置更鞏固：城頭以弩列壓制進逼的攻城步兵與攀城者，陣前以床弩與弩車打擊密集隊形，弩手與弓手搭配，覆蓋從塹溝到城頭的縱深，弩機的形制與數量也隨著守城的需要而增加。對西魏而言，關中自此更加倚重屯田與軍府制，兵農合一的路線在往後十數年裡定型，等到大統十六年再有事時，關中已能一次調出相當可觀的兵力的物質基礎。最後，這一役也提醒雙方：洛陽是可以守住的，但要守得便宜，就必須靠地形與器械，而不是靠一次會戰的勝負。
impactEn: The direct effect of the engagement was that Luoyang and the line of Mount Mang stayed in the hands of Eastern Wei, and later of Northern Qi, for more than a decade; the line between east and west settled roughly along the northern foot of the Xiaohan mountains and the south bank of the Yellow River, the sorties of Western Wei were repeatedly stopped at the mouths of the valleys, and the north and south routes of the Central Plain remained in the hands of the northern court. The indirect effect was larger: the system of defence of Luozhou and Henan was reinforced, the ditches, the forts and the beacon towers were strung together again along the south bank of the river, the distance of reporting between the line of Tongguan and Luoyang was shortened, the water transport of the Heluo region once more became the artery of the northern state, while the large armies in Guanzhong had to be kept alive by a long grain road. As for the weapons, the repeated sieges and frontier skirmishes of these years fixed the place of the crossbow in the system even more firmly: lines of crossbows on the wall pressed the infantry coming up against the works and the men scaling the masonry, bed crossbows and crossbow carts broke up the dense formations in front of the line, crossbowmen and archers were paired so that the depth from the ditch to the parapet was covered, and the number and the pattern of the mechanisms grew with the needs of the defence. As for Western Wei, Guanzhong leaned harder on the farming garrisons and on the military houses, and the line of soldiers and farmers together took shape over the following ten-odd years, so that by the sixteenth year of Datong, when there was again business of their own, Guanzhong had the material basis for moving a considerable force at one time. In the end the engagement taught both sides the same lesson: Luoyang could be held, but to hold it cheaply one had to rely on the ground and on the machines, not on the result of a single set-piece battle.
result: 結果是東魏守住邙山與洛陽，西魏退回崤函與關中，雙方都沒有在這條戰線上分出勝負，也沒有留下可供核對的斬獲數字。現存記載有限，但可以確定的是幾件事：戰場在洛陽以北的邙山一線，交戰的性質偏向前哨與拉鋸而非大會戰；東魏的守方以洛州兵與河南的騎兵為主，弩手與塹線是骨幹，西魏的出關部隊在糧秣與援兵都受限制的情況下試探，見勢不利即退回崤函；同年東魏的注意力同時被柔然吸往北方，這是這場交戰得以在中等規模上發生的直接原因。結果的另一面是戰線的固化：洛陽方向此後以塹堡與烽燧為骨架進行長期的守禦，東西之間的爭奪轉入另一種節奏——不是年年大戰，而是年年拉鋸；秦弩一類的守城器械也在這套骨架裡得到最充分的用武之地，弩機的批量生產與標準化，正是秦人留下的那一條技術傳統在六朝最成功的延續。
resultEn: The result was that Eastern Wei held Mount Mang and Luoyang and Western Wei withdrew towards the Xiaohan passes and Guanzhong; neither side won a decision on this front, and no tally of the slain survives that can be checked. The record is thin, but a number of things can be settled. The field was the line of Mount Mang north of Luoyang; the nature of the engagement leaned towards an outpost action and a long grinding contest rather than a set-piece battle; the Eastern Wei defence rested on the troops of Luozhou and on the cavalry of Henan, with the crossbowmen and the ditch line as its backbone, while the Western Wei force that came out of the passes probed forward under restrictions on grain and on reinforcement and withdrew towards the Xiaohan mountains as soon as the position turned; the attention of Eastern Wei was drawn northwards by the Rouran in the same year, and that was the direct reason why this engagement could take place at the scale it did. The other side of the result was the hardening of the front: from then on the Luoyang direction was defended for the long term with ditches, forts and beacon towers as its skeleton, and the contest between east and west settled into a different rhythm, not a great battle every year but a grinding contest every year. Weapons of the Qin crossbow family found their fullest use inside that skeleton, and the mass production and the standardisation of the trigger mechanism was the most successful continuation into the sixth century of the technical tradition the Qin had left behind.
